title: Lab-on-a-CD Platform for Generating Multicellular Three-dimensional Spheroids
protocol: Centrifugal microfluidic-based spheroid (CMS) culture chip fabrication.
Make PC molds for the top and bottom layers by CNC machining.
Mix PDMS base and curing agent at a ratio of 10:1 (w/w).
Place mixed PDMS in a desiccator for 1 hour to remove air bubbles.
Pour PDMS mixture into molds and remove air bubbles for 1 hour.
Cure PDMS mixture in a heat chamber at 80 °C for 2 hours.
Expose PDMS surfaces to air-assisted plasma at 18 W for 30 seconds.
Bond the two layers of the CMS culture chip.
Place bonded chip in the heat chamber at 80 °C for 30 minutes.
Sterilize the CMS culture chip in an autoclave at 121 °C and 15 psi.
Thaw a vial containing 5 × 10^5–1 × 10^6 hASCs or MRC-5 cells in a water bath at 36.5 °C for 2 minutes.
Add 1 mL of Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) to the vial and gently mix with a pipette.
Transfer 15 mL of prewarmed DMEM to a Petri dish using a pipette.
Add cells from the vial to the Petri dish containing DMEM.
Aspirate DMEM after 1 day and replace with fresh DMEM.
Change media every 2 or 3 days.
Add 4 mL of trypsin to the Petri dishes.
Place the Petri dishes in an incubator at 36.5 °C and 5% CO2 for 4 min.
Put 2.5 mL of 4% (w/v) pluronic F-127 solution into the inlet hole of the CMS culture chip while rotating the chip at 500–1,000 rpm.
Rotate the chip at 4,000 rpm for 3 min using the CMS system.
Incubate the CMS culture chip filled with pluronic solution overnight at 36.5 °C in 5% CO2.
Remove the pluronic solution from the CMS culture chip.
Wash out the remaining pluronic solution with DMEM.
Dry the chip for 12 h on a clean bench.
Add 2.5 mL of DMEM to the CMS culture chip.
Rotate the chip at ~4,000 rpm for 3 min for prewetting the inside of the chip.
Pull out 100 μL of DMEM from the CMS culture chip to make room for injecting the cell suspension.
Add 100 μL of cell suspensions containing either 5 × 10^5 hASCs or 8 × 10^5 MRC-5s by pipetting.
Uniformly distribute the cells by pipetting 3–5 times for resuspension.
Rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min to trap cells in each microwell by centrifugal force.
Culture the cells for 3 days in the incubator at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2, rotating at 1,000–2,000 rpm.
Change culture medium every day.
Add the first cells, 2.5 × 10^5 hASCs, and rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm.
After 3 min, add the second cells, 4 × 10^5 MRC-5s, and rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min.
Inject a total of 100 μL of cell suspensions by pipetting.
Shift the rotational speed to 500-1,000 rpm when cells are injected.
Culture the cells in the incubator at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2 by rotating at 1,000–2,000 rpm.
Change the culture medium every day for long-term culture.
Add 100 μL of cell suspensions containing 2.5 × 10^5 hASCs by pipetting while the chip rotates at 500-1,000 rpm.
Rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min after adding the first set of cells.
Incubate the chip at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2 by rotating at 1,000-2,000 rpm for 3 h.
Add 100 μL of cell suspensions containing 4 × 10^5 MRC-5s by pipetting while the chip rotates at 500-1,000 rpm.
Rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min after adding the second set of cells.
Culture the cells in the incubator at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2 by rotating at 1,000-2,000 rpm.
Change the culture medium every day for long-term culture.
Add 100 μL of cell suspensions containing 1.5 × 10^5 hASCs by pipetting while the chip rotates at 500-1,000 rpm.
Rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min after adding the first set of cells.
Incubate the chip at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2 by rotating at 1,000–2,000 rpm for 3 h.
Add 100 μL of cell suspensions containing 3 × 10^5 MRC-5s by pipetting while the chip rotates at 500–1,000 rpm.
Rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min.
Incubate the chip at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2 by rotating at 1,000–2,000 rpm for another 3 h.
Add 100 μL of cell suspensions containing 1.5 × 10^5 hASCs by pipetting while the chip rotates at 500–1,000 rpm.
Rotate the chip at 3,000 rpm for 3 min.
Culture the cells in the incubator at 36.5 °C, >95% humidity, and 5% CO2 by rotating at 1,000–2,000 rpm until sandwich spheroids are created within 12 h.
Change the culture medium every day for long-term culture.
Warm the cell fluorescence dye to room temperature (20 °C).
Add 20 μL of anhydrous dimethylsulfoxide (DMSO) per vial to make a 1 mM solution.
Dilute the fluorescence to a final working concentration of 1 μM using DMEM.
Add the fluorescence to the cell suspension and gently resuspend using a pipette.
Incubate for 20 min at 36.5 °C, humidity >95%, and 5% CO2.
